messages:
dario: Quick follow-up from today's infra section: can someone give a compact answer on headroom targets, how prewarm eviction works, and whether cross-region fallbacks affect SLAs/billing?

kai_infra: Headroom target = 18% in primary regions (us-west-2, eu-west-1) for H2. Eviction order = spot -> burst -> reserved. Prewarm nodes inherit reserved semantics unless created with 'preemptible_prewarm=true'.

olivia_product: On billing/SLA: default behavior is we treat model-variant fallbacks as functionally equivalent for success SLAs (no extra charge). Cross-region is opt-in; if enabled, customers may see egress billed separately and we'll mark requests as "served_with_fallback:cross_region" in metrics.

raj_ops: Autoscaler path = local_prewarm -> model_variant (quantized) -> cross_region. Default cross-region latency threshold = 150ms, exposed as config 'regional_fallback_max_latency_ms'.

emma_support: For CS: draft canned response: "If a request shows 'served_with_fallback' it may have used a quantized model or been routed to a fallback region. Check request logs for details or open a ticket for a per-request trace."

scale_bot: autoscaler: prewarm +4 us-west-2 (scheduled campaign)

dario: Action items: Kai to write eviction one-pager + config keys; Olivia to prepare console copy for the opt-in toggle and pricing note; Emma to update CS FAQ and incident tags (fallback_type, fallback_reason). Target: drafts by next Wed EOD.

kai_infra: I'll drop a short spec and example config snippet in this thread by EOD Wednesday.

dario: Thanks all :rocket:
